section_3_redundancy_ratio.methodology: Redundancy Ratio = total v1 defect-class scan instances / total v2 defect-class scan instances, computed per-session and cross-session.

per_session_ratio.interpretation: v1 runs 2.17× more defect-class scan instances per session than v2. A typical v1 session deploys 13 agent-level scans that v2 handles with 6 automated scanner executions.

cross_session_ratio_4_session_chain.interpretation: Over 4 sessions examining the same 38 seeds, v1 accumulated 6.33× more redundant scan instances. The cross-session compounding effect means v1's redundancy grows linearly with session count while v2 remains constant (scan once, consume many).

certification_wave_ratio_estimated.scenario: A 6-session certification wave (Domain E: S313→S318 pattern)
certification_wave_ratio_estimated.note: v2 scans once at T0 of Wave 1 and reuses artifacts across all 6 sessions (delta re-scan only for changed items). v1 re-scans all items in every session. The ratio compounds: 13 scans/session × 6 sessions = 78 vs. 6 (once + delta rechecks).

section_5_scan_artifacts_storage.description: Storage footprint of scan artifacts per session under v1 vs v2.

v1_storage_per_session.source: S200 Agent G — Reporting Burden Analysis: 1,212 total reports, 11.7 avg/session (800-series). S300-series sessions: S301 (30), S304 (11), S306 (9), S308 (24), S310 (11), S313 (9), S315 (~10), S317 (9), S320 (~5). Mean: ~15 files.
v1_storage_per_session.scan_containing_files_range: 5–15 files per session containing defect-class scan results
v1_storage_per_session.breakdown: ~10 scan-output files × ~20KB avg JSON + ~5 summary files × ~10KB = ~250KB
v1_storage_per_session.duplicate_content_note: S200 Agent G: 65% of session-prefixed files (594 of 914 in sample) are never referenced again. Core metrics (certified count, DL-008/DL-026 counts, governance status) appear in 4-7 files per session (S200 duplicate_reporting analysis).

v2_storage_per_session.note: 15 scans × 5 packs = 75 files, but only if all scans are per-pack. In practice, cross-pack scans (PG-AN-01 through PG-AN-04, PG-006) produce fewer files. Estimated actual: ~35-45 files per session.
v2_storage_per_session.breakdown: ~40 files × ~5KB avg JSON (structured, minimal redundancy, machine-consumable format) = ~200KB
v2_storage_per_session.unique_content_note: Each artifact covers a distinct defect class. Zero cross-file metric duplication. Boards consume artifacts, not produce new ones — reporting is consolidated to 4 files/session per S200 Target Architecture.

storage_comparison.deduplication_benefit_explanation: v2 produces slightly more total bytes (more structured per-item data) but eliminates the 65% duplicate-content penalty. v1's 250KB has ~162KB of duplicate information (appearing in 4-7 overlapping files). v2's 200KB has ~196KB of unique information. Effective unique content ratio: v1 = 88KB unique, v2 = 196KB unique → v2 delivers 2.2× more unique information per byte.

cumulative_10_sessions.v2_delivers_more_unique_information: 2.24× more unique structural/quality data per cumulative byte over 10 sessions

v1_problems_resolved_by_v2.v1_symptom: S313 produced 29 Gate 4 scanner observations that were ALL false positives (0% pass rate) — regex-based scan patterns flagged substantively correct content. S318 Agent A and Agent B produced overlapping gate verification results. S809 Agent C and Agent D disagreed on CorrectChoice for 5/38 seeds because they used different extraction methodologies.
v1_problems_resolved_by_v2.v2_fix: AM-1 Function Constructor within-object extraction mandated for all scans (S202 Amendment 1). Single scan methodology eliminates between-agent methodology variance. Per-item QID lists mandatory (FM-005 prohibition). Count stability verified by dual run (idempotency requirement).

v1_problems_resolved_by_v2.v1_symptom: S320 discovered that S319's seed inventory had stale CorrectChoice values — live pack files had rotated CC values since inventory creation. 0 seeds were actually certification-ready because the inventory targeted wrong CC slots. Without identity validation, perfectly executing scans produce perfectly wrong results.
v1_problems_resolved_by_v2.v2_fix: PG-011 Identity scan runs at Gate -1 before any defect scan. Every item's compound key (QID+CC+pack) is verified against live file content. S320-style staleness is impossible — identity is re-verified at every T0.

v1_problems_resolved_by_v2.problem: Scan results not consumed across sessions
v1_problems_resolved_by_v2.v1_symptom: S809→S809.1→S809.2→S810.1 chain: 4 sessions independently re-discovered the same DL-008/DL-026/DL-013 findings on the same 38 seeds. S809.2's CC discrepancy discovery was missed by S809's 28 agents. No mechanism existed to 'consume' S809's scan results in S809.1 — each session started from scratch.
v1_problems_resolved_by_v2.v2_fix: Artifacts stored at reports/scans/gate_N/ with timestamps and QID lists. Boards consume artifacts without re-executing. Delta review engine queries prior artifact for content_hash match → auto-inherits PASS verdict. No re-discovery cycle.

v1_problems_resolved_by_v2.problem: Board time wasted on structurally detectable defects
v1_problems_resolved_by_v2.v1_symptom: 100% readiness failure rate (S200 Agent F): 38/38 Domain E seeds reached S809 board with 0 pre-board structural scans. DL-008/DL-026/DL-013/DL-016 were latent since original authoring. Boards convened on unready inventory — 89.5% of items needed 2-3 extra sessions before certification.
v1_problems_resolved_by_v2.v2_fix: Mandatory pre-flight gate: all 11 structural/content scans must PASS before any item enters board review. Items with HARD_BLOCK defects (DL-008, DL-026, DL-016, JSON integrity) are routed to Editorial Queue — never reach a board. Board time converts from defect-discovery to certification-decision.

v1_problems_resolved_by_v2.problem: Agent self-report reliance without independent verification
v1_problems_resolved_by_v2.v1_symptom: Agent C claimed '197 DL-008 cleared' but actual count was 336 (DL-019: 432 items silently re-contaminated). Agent D claimed '74 Pack C DL-008 cleared' but Tier 0 re-scan found 175 remaining. Agent A claimed '0 DL-008 remaining' but enforcement-depth scan found 52 Certified items with DL-008. Per AGENTS.md §5, self-reported claims must be independently verified.
v1_problems_resolved_by_v2.v2_fix: All scan outputs include per-item QID lists (FM-005 prohibition). Scan engine enforces dual-run count stability. Governance guard Rules 6-8 read artifacts at T0/Tmid/Tend. Self-report reliance eliminated — artifacts are the authoritative source.

remaining_gaps.PG_006_DL030_cost: DL-030 CorrectChoice ground-truth verification scans require AI-powered independent re-derivation. At 30s for 2,500 items, this is the single most expensive scan and has no v1 equivalent (v1 never systematically verified all answer keys). This is net-new capability, not a saved cost.
remaining_gaps.delta_infrastructure_prerequisite: Content_hash infrastructure (per-item SHA-256) required for PG-006 delta mode and certification inheritance. Not yet implemented. Full re-scan at every T0 until available. S200 Agent I estimated 16-21 sessions upfront investment.
remaining_gaps.case_item_scan_gap: PG-009 EV8 case path relies on case-specific object format (Correct field vs CorrectChoice, explanation field naming). Case-item scans are less mature than MCQ scans. PG-AN-02 Metadata Completeness for cases requires schema conformance not yet validated at scale.
